additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0412698-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002752] allOutletsUnavailable CRM:00921001632
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well.
There are maybe two possible reasons:
The device is broken --> If so, then need to replace it.
The feedback line to analog input KF7 is broken (output 2V=0V at DC...10V=1000V at DC)
Kindly check above loose wiring connection or damaged with safety guidelines. First is to swap TF1 by TF2 to understand if the issue stays on the outlet 2 or move to outlet 1. Second suggestion is to make a direct wire from TF2 to the PLC analog input board to check if the issue in on the wirings.
For details, please find the KA Link-
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&forceUCI=1&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=knowledgearticle&id=46e60460-98ae-ee11-a569-000d3aba351f

MLFB-8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5  & MLFB-6ES7193-6BP00-0BA0
